rationale: The source-grounded contrast requires Quartz=high in Rowan and Quartz=low in tolerated-control Mica. The candidate changes Mica's Quartz value from low to high, eliminating the represented feature discrimination while the exposure is held constant. That discrepancy can change whether the material hypothesis passes the tolerated-control/specificity gate and therefore whether the conclusion 'Quartz survives the represented comparison' is permitted.
